name: MCSRP7
description: MCSRP7 uses Intel Pentium J3700 / J3710 processors, up to 8GB DDR3L and four Intel i225-V B3 2.5GbE ports. The 120 x 107.5 x 36.5 mm fanless aluminum chassis includes mSATA, SATA, COM, HDMI and DisplayPort.

specs.label: CPU
specs.value: Intel Pentium J3700 / J3710 (Braswell; 4 cores, 4 threads)

specs.label: Memory
specs.value: 1 x DDR3L SO-DIMM, 1600 / 1333 MHz, max 8 GB

specs.label: Network
specs.value: 4 x Intel i225-V B3 2.5 GbE LAN

specs.label: USB
specs.value: 2 x external USB 3.0; 1 x internal USB 2.0 header

specs.label: Other
specs.value: 1 x COM; 1 x combo audio jack; Wi-Fi antenna openings

specs.label: Expansion - Wi-Fi
specs.value: 1 x mini PCIe slot for 2.4 / 5 GHz Wi-Fi module

specs.label: Internal I/O
specs.value: 1 x USB 2.0; 1 x F_PANEL; 1 x SATA power

specs.label: Power
specs.value: 12 V DC, 5.5 x 2.5 mm barrel connector

specs.label: Enclosure
specs.value: Aluminum alloy, fanless passive cooling; black

specs.label: Front I/O
specs.value: Power button; combo audio; 2 x USB 3.0; COM; HDMI 1.4; DP 1.2

specs.label: Rear I/O
specs.value: 4 x 2.5 GbE; DC 12 V; power and drive status LEDs
